title: Customer returns
note: Cash refund from the original open drawer. This record does not issue a fiscal document or reverse card or Pix payments.
permission: Permission to return sales is required.
storage: Invalid or unavailable pending local record. Preserve the data and request review. No new submission was started.
session: The session context changed. Sign in again to query the original operation.
notFound: Sale or operation not found, or this service does not support the function.
conflict: Balance, quantity, quote, drawer or history changed. Query the operation and refresh before deciding.
failed: Operation incomplete or invalid reply. If submitted, query the pending operation.
writeUnavailable: Submission requires permission, an active POS license and cross-tab locking.
pendingNote: Query first. Resending preserves the same identifier and payload without creating another refund.
no_restock: Do not add to saleable stock
quantityNote: Use the sale unit with up to three decimal places. Leave other items blank.
inspection: Restocking requires human inspection. Damaged goods must remain outside saleable stock.
quoteNote: A quote does not reserve quantities or pay cash. Check items, disposition, reason and total.
confirmReview: I checked the items, reason, condition of the goods and cash refund.
recorded: Operation confirmed in the official record. Keep the original reference.
missing: Operation not found yet. The request was preserved. Query again or explicitly resend the same request.
